entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: This should be the same as the slots.[n]We will have to put a halt to their[n]cheating.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: We knew what we were getting involved[n]with going in. We are phantom thieves,[n]after all.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: There's no other way, yeah? We gotta do[n]this shit!

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Indeed. We will use the equipment here[n]to our advantage to rig the game in our[n]favor.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Wait, this is a job for me! It'll be a breeze!

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: The odds here are stacked against us.[n]We would never win if we stuck to normal[n]methods.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: We do not have any time to waste either.[n]It would be best for us to focus on our[n]objective.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...You're right. Changing my sister's heart[n]is the ultimate goal here.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I feel bad asking this, but may we borrow[n]your expertise yet another time, Oracle?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I'm game! But man, you sure give a lot of[n]orders for a noob!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Okay, I rigged one of the rooms[n]in our favor, just like Crow said.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: The other rooms should at least be back[n]to normal honest gambling now too.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Anyway, I marked our special room on[n]the map. Make sure you use that one!

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Perfect. Now, let us head into the fray.
